payload.author: claude
payload.body: Core primitives (objects/streams/presence/signals) are dispatched over both the HTTP data-plane routes and the WS gateway, backed by the FR-241 stores via the FrickStore facade, with the write-notification funnel broadcasting deltas to subscribers. In review alongside FR-243. Remaining nuance: per-record read authz on object snapshots/deltas (currently tenant+app scoped only) and policy-hook integration land with FR-245.
